meaning.zh:
“轻而易举的事” 或 “非常简单的事情”。

这个俗语起源于20世纪初的美国，“piece of cake” 是指某些特定的竞赛中获胜的奖品——蛋糕——于是这个短语逐渐演变成一种口语用法，用以表示某事非常容易完成。类似于中文中的 “小菜一碟”。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from early 20th century America, where "piece of cake" referred to a prize in certain competitions—a cake. Over time, it evolved into a colloquial expression used to indicate that something is very easy to accomplish, similar to the Chinese expression “小菜一碟”.

lines.en: Don't worry about the test; it's a piece of cake.
lines.zh: 别担心考试；这简直小菜一碟。

lines.en: Fixing this bike is a piece of cake for me.
lines.zh: 修理这辆自行车对我来说简直轻而易举。

lines.en: Compared to the problems we faced last year, this one is a piece of cake.
lines.zh: 和我们去年面对的问题相比，这个简直太容易了。
